reason: Prose names the range 4:4-7, which is accurate: 4:4 has the robbing, plundering and rebellion, and 4:7 (card) has 'still extended to do evil ... Yahuah was very wroth' — the Genesis 6:5 wickedness. Range ends on the card's verse; no address to correct.

Prose names 12:10 and 12:16 together and both are right: 12:10 is the substituted child the king killed, 12:16 is Terah before the king as Abram's death is pressed (sentence falls in next, 12:17). Card sits on one of the two named verses.

Prose names the range 29:14-17: 29:14 is the wives vexing Isaac and Rebecca, 29:16 (prev) 'daughters of Heth', 29:17 (card) Adah the Hittite wife bearing Eliphaz. Card is inside the range; 29:14 would be the strongest single verse for 'grieved Isaac' but the range is not wrong.
Prose names the range 30:1-3: 30:1 the night at Luz when Yahuah appeared, 30:3 (card) Jacob waking from the vision and naming Bethel. Card is inside the range.
Prose names the range 31:19-21: 31:19 the prayer, 31:21 (card) 'Elohim (God) heard her and opened her womb' — the answer Genesis 30:22 records. Card is on the best verse and inside the range.

Note says 'the dread Judah expects to fall on the Canaanite kings (Jasher 34:55)'; 34:55 is the verse that names 'all the Canaanitish kings' delivered into our hands. 34:60 (card) is the call to gird on weapons, 'He will save us', and has no kings. Prose address is right; move the card.
Prose names the range 34:55-60 and the card sits on its last verse, 'Yahuah (the Lord) is our Elohim, He will save us' — the terror Judah counts on. Range is accurate.
Prose names the range 34:23-28: 34:23 the oath, 34:27 (prev) 'left not a male remaining', 34:28 (card) Hamor and Shechem slain and Dinah brought away. Card is inside the range and ends it.
Prose names the range 47:15-19: 47:15 Esau proposes the division, 47:19 (card) Jacob offers land or riches. Card is inside the range.
Prose names the range 48:62-64; 48:64 (card) 'those signs which Joseph had spoken to the king came to pass on that day' is the exact match for Genesis 41:13 'as he interpreted to us, so it was'.
Prose names the range 66:12-14; 66:14 (card) is the king asking his counsellors for counsel against Israel. Card is inside the range.
Prose names the range 71:1-3; 71:3 (card) 'he smote the Egyptian and hid him in the sand' is the Jubilees 47:10 deed itself.

Prose names the range 87:1-3; 87:1 is the direct Numbers parallel ('take now Joshua the son of Nun your servant') and 87:3 (card) is Yahuah's charge to Joshua in the tabernacle. Card is inside the range; nothing stale, though 87:1 is the closer single verse.
